highlights: Easy-Swich Across 3 Devices: Connect up to 3 wireless devices via Bluetooth 5.3 and 2.4GHz USB receiver, and switch between them with one click of the Easy-Switch buttons
Ultra-Portable Mini Keyboard: The UGREEN wireless keyboard is particularly slim (0.29 inches) and light (312g), making it easy to carry in your laptop bag, perfect for travel or on-the-go

Up to 500-Day Battery Life: The Bluetooth keyboard with auto-sleep power-saving mode gives you up to 500 days of use (Note: Data based on 2 hours of non-stop use per day; 2 x AAA batteries not included)

Comfort Typing at Your Fingertips: The mini keyborad comes with scissor-foot structure and a familiar, laptop-like typing experience for effortless, comfy typing and provide same typing feel with 90% less noise
9° Tile Ergonomic Design: With a tilt angle of 9 degrees, the UGREEN keyboard is easy to type on, and it helps to prevent wobbling and reduce fatigue during long typing sessions on the go
Wide Compatibilty: This computer keyboard is compatible with Windows 11/10/8.1/7, macOS 10.15 and above, iPadOS 14.0 and above, iOS 13.4 and above, Android 5.0 and above, Linux and Chrome OS
